assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's one curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit: 09_QUEEN_ORDER_GOVERNANCE_SOLITUDE_AND_REFORM.md (74,423 bytes, status canonical, veto false), Phase-3 specialist synthesis 9 of the To Be Hero X V2 corpus, centered on Liu Yuwei / Queen with Bowa, Lucky Cyan (Qīng), the Johnnies, DOS and X as relational context. Its source is the frozen Mandarin-primary Season 1 E01-E24 readings, the Phase-2 ledgers and claim register, the E20 motion audit and targeted clip TBHX-AV-E11-001; Queen's evidence is drawn from E11-E13, E19, E20 and E24. Read in full by the evaluator. The episode readings, ledgers and the project's pending Document 20 character model are not curated on this subject and were not used. The evaluator performed no audiovisual inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Season 1 E01-E24, with the item's four stages split at located changes: Stage 1-2, E11 (entrance examination about 00:01:00-00:03:30; rejection of the genius label at 00:04:17.750; manifesto from about 00:05:15); the post-X crisis at the E11 tournament (TBHX-AV-E11-001, nominal 00:19:48.644-00:21:40.297); Stage 3, E12 (Little Johnny at the closed door 00:06:06.500; the song line 00:07:47.500; rescue 00:09:54.500; loopholes 00:13:59.500; `不破不立` 00:18:52.620; hospital 00:20:48.880; self-reliance 00:22:06.000); E13 broadcast as remembered precedent (00:02:50.750); E19 vacation call (CN 9-28); Stage 4, E20 emergency domain (00:17:34.654-00:20:44.489); E24 tournament field (about 00:20:31-00:23:08). assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: A stated, located mechanism: self-authorship against explanatory capture (E11 00:04:17.750), scaled into sovereign authorship (sections 3-5), resting on a learned belief that only self-reliance is safe (E12 00:22:06.000), broken by an illegible defeat (section 14) and revised toward self-binding, revisable rule and accepted care (sections 22-25). It supports narrow predictions: she refuses accounts that credit her outcome to others, prefers named competition to false harmony, and accepts help when it does not claim her authorship. Not B: the item does not establish which priority decides when reform ambition, relationships and institutional standing compete outside the one E12 template; whether she keeps the overthrow goal and whether she accepts correction from people she does not trust are protected questions (section 43 Q3, Q6). Not D: the mechanism is explicit and tied to timestamped dialogue.

Four political stages (section 31) with located transitions: E11 manifesto, the TBHX-AV-E11-001 crisis, E12 recovery sequence at timestamps, E19 chosen relation, E20 emergency domain, E24 placement in the common field. Development is ordered without erasing earlier positions (section 21's narrative order). Not A: E19 and E24 are thinly sampled (one call, field placement), and her exact E24 role is open (Q14). Not C: each stage transition carries a timestamp or line locator.

Located Mandarin anchors for distinct modes: the manifesto lexicon (`制定规则`, `新规`, `秩序`, `推翻信赖值体系`), rejection of false harmony (`虚情假意`), gratitude framed as expression (`是你的歌声给了我力量`), the self-binding turn (`不破不立`, `规则既能约束他人 / 强化自己`) and confession (`达成目标只能相信自己和依靠自己`), glossed in section 36. Not B: register is not conditioned by recipient (Bowa, Qīng, Micky, Little Johnny) or state beyond these lines, and the vocal and silence patterns of manifesto, collapse, recovery and command are a protected question (Q17). Not D: the anchors are located and distinguish several modes.

Only scattered ordinary scenes: the entrance examination (E11), food left at her closed door (E12), the vacation call and travel invitation (E19). No routine, domestic or leisure behavior is modeled. Not D: nothing distributed beyond these local scenes.

Distinct located accounts per partner (section 39): Bowa as authorship mirror and rival (E11 confrontation, E12 loophole and `不破不立`), Qīng as the relation that discloses an inner possibility without claiming it (E12 00:07:47.500, 00:22:25.250), Little Johnny as presence without pressure (E12 00:06:06.500), Big Johnny as affect she cannot command (E11), Liu Zhen as source of concealed history, Micky and DOS as aligned but asymmetric sponsor, X as illegible rival. Not B: the accounts are developmental readings of single episodes rather than conditioned response policies, and whether the recovery circle lasts or can challenge her politically, and the Queen-Qīng relationship, are open (section 35, Q11-Q12). Not D: each relationship is located and differentiated.

Located inner states: involuntary attention to Big Johnny (`身体和眼睛不受控制`, E11), the post-X crisis of control shown in posture and withdrawal (TBHX-AV-E11-001), the learned self-reliance belief (E12 00:22:06.000) and `内心中的另一个声音` (E12 00:22:25.250). Not B: the content of the other voice is open (Q2), the crisis is read from visual form without lexical access, and her inner response to E19-E24 events is sparse. Not D: several inner states are located and tied to conduct.

Conflict templates: explicit competition with Bowa and refusal of handed-over status (E11), the bounded rule field and Bowa's loophole critique (E12 00:13:59.500), self-directed rule and stopping Bowa at the cost of the tournament (E12 00:18:52.620-00:20:39.120), defeat by X without usable exchange (E11), and cooperative containment before Lucky Cyan's restoration (E20 motion audit). Not B: the syntax, cost and limits of her power are protected questions (Q7-Q8), and interpersonal conflict is sampled mainly with Bowa. Not D: the templates are located and ordered.

Located positions: description must not own the meaning of an act (E11), influence is not ownership (E13 through section 8), immediate rescue outweighs the climb to X when they conflict (E12, section 21), and emergency order should be local and open to care (E20). Not B: much of the governance analysis (consent, appeal, review, rights limits) is the analyst's constitutional frame rather than her deliberation, and whether she revises the overthrow program or would govern non-heroes is open (Q3-Q6, Q16). Not D: her stated positions and one costly choice are located.
The item does not analyze her humor or play; the Big Johnny `太可爱了` moment is read as affect, not humor.

One canonical specialist synthesis covering every episode in which the item places her (E11-E13, E19, E20, E24), with timestamp and cue-line locators (section 42) and explicit notice of what is not motion-audited. Not B: only this item is curated; some E11 sequences and E19 carry approximate or cue-only locators, acoustic audition is pending in the project, and the episode readings and ledgers are not on the row. Not D: coverage is complete for her appearances and located.

Adversarial readings with sourced dispositions (section 40): luck as the cause of her recovery is rejected by her own E12 line; the bottles support alcohol coding but no diagnosis (ALT-09-10); abandoning ambition after friendship is rejected by her continued frontline and tournament presence (ALT-09-12); canonical romance with Qīng is open (ALT-09-11). Not A: none is tested against held-out source. Not C: the contradictions are located and scoped.

Timestamp-level locators for E11, E12, E13, the E11 clip, the E20 clip and E24, with cue-line numbers and sheets (section 42), and an ordered stage model. Not A: several E11 sequences are located only by scene, E19 only by cue range, and E24 positions beyond source-explicit ones are excluded. Not C: most state claims are dated and located.

conditions: Illustrative lines only, at a named stage, never presented as quotation.

Manifesto and political statements in the juridical lexicon (rules, order, overthrow) at Stage 2; refusal of false harmony with rivals; after E12, gratitude framed as what another person's expression made possible, never as luck or service.
No register claims by recipient beyond these modes, and no acoustic, vocal or silence claims (Q17).
scenario_readiness.note: Located Mandarin anchors constrain statement-level output for a few modes; register by recipient is not modeled.

conditions: Chronology is one named stage: E11 before the tournament, the E11 aftermath, E12 after recovery, or E19-E24; the post-E12 states may not be projected back.
The interlocutor is Bowa, Qīng / Lucky Cyan, Little or Big Johnny, Liu Zhen or Micky / DOS. Any other interlocutor is a separate, lower-confidence condition.

Predictions are limited to the item's located patterns: refusing causal-credit capture, naming competition over false harmony, choosing immediate rescue over advancement on the E12 template, accepting care without ceding authorship after E12, and local cooperative containment on the E20 template.
Her reform program, correction by people she does not trust, governance of non-heroes, the limits of her power and the Queen-Qīng relationship are output as open forks.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named stage within Season 1 E11-E24; no events after E24. Her childhood self-reliance lesson is her memory at every stage.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Bowa as rival, Qīng / Lucky Cyan as friend and partner in crisis, Little and Big Johnny as neighbors and recovery circle, Liu Zhen as father, Micky / DOS as sponsor; others only at lower confidence.
setting_constraints: Season 1 hero society: Commission, DOS, Hero Tower ranking and public media
Hero work, tournament competition or an emergency where her bounded rule-space is used
No peacetime governance, constitutional design or post-Season-1 politics
Named open questions end in an open fork

scenario_readiness.note: Narrow extrapolation from located patterns inside Season 1 hero society.
The item shows only a few ordinary-care scenes and leaves her vulnerability outside crisis open (section 35).

conditions: Questions of explanatory credit, influence versus ownership, named competition versus false harmony, and immediate rescue versus advancement.
Emergency questions where bounded containment can make room for another person's care (E20).
No answers on her replacement institutions, consent, appeal, rights limits or governance of non-heroes (Q4-Q6, Q16).
scenario_readiness.note: Located positions support credit, harmony and local-obligation questions; her governance program is open.
Season 1 establishes no romantic relationship, and the Queen-Qīng bond is explicitly unlabeled (ALT-09-11, Q11).

conditions: Hero work as observed: public rescue (E12), tournament competition (E11, E24), emergency containment in cooperation with a restorative hero (E20), and an aligned but asymmetric relationship with DOS (sections 7 and 26).
Rule-space behavior is limited to observed uses: constraining a rival, self-strengthening and emergency containment; its syntax, cost and limits stay open (Q7-Q8).
No institutional leadership, policy design or command beyond the observed emergency.
scenario_readiness.note: Read as her hero career inside DOS and the ranking system.

known_limits.statement: Whether she revises or abandons overthrowing the Trust Value system, and what institutions she would build, is open.
Whether she accepts correction from institutions or people she does not already trust is open.
The syntax, cost, duration and resistance limits of her rule power, and how self-strengthening relates to outward constraint, are not established.
Vocal, musical and silence patterns across manifesto, collapse, recovery and command are a protected question.
The content of the inner voice she hears through Qīng's song is open.
The long-term Queen-Qīng relationship is open and not canonically romantic in Season 1.
Whether the recovery circle lasts outside crisis, or can challenge her political decisions, is open.
The E11 aftermath strongly codes solitary drinking, but exact contents, dependence and any diagnosis are unsupported.
Her evidence comes from E11-E13, E19, E20 and E24; E19 and E24 are thin.
No operational character model is curated on this subject; the item is a literary and political synthesis without response policies.
Ordinary and domestic behavior is barely sampled.
